test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Among the following, which is not a qualification for membership in the Vidhan Sabha

options.text: Not hold any office of profit
Have attained the age of 25 Years

solution:
The correct answer is __**Knowledge of Politics**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Knowledge of Politics** is not a required qualification for membership in the Vidhan Sabha.
 
• To be a member of the Vidhan Sabha, one must:
 
 
• **Not hold any office of profit** under the government of India or the government of any state.
 
• Be a citizen of India</strong&
